name: nextiq-chat
description: Chat UI for NextIQ backed by the Thrio prediction API.

scripts.deploy:staging: node --check server.js && gcloud functions deploy nextiq-staging --project=voicebot-451222 --region=us-central1 --gen2 --runtime=nodejs22 --trigger-http --allow-unauthenticated --entry-point=nextiq --source=. --env-vars-file=env/staging.yaml --timeout=300
scripts.deploy:production: node --check server.js && gcloud functions deploy nextiq-production --project=voicebot-451222 --region=us-central1 --gen2 --runtime=nodejs22 --trigger-http --allow-unauthenticated --entry-point=nextiq --source=. --env-vars-file=env/production.yaml --timeout=300
